options: Encrypting data so it cannot be read
Changing data values to meet business requirements
Rearranging or formatting data so that it becomes understandable or usable
Deleting irrelevant records from a dataset
Copying data from one server to another
questions.explanation: Data Parsing is about rearranging or formatting data in such a way that it is understandable or usable, without changing its meaning.

questions.stem: Which of the following does Data Parsing NOT do to data?
options: Make it usable in reports and dashboards
Anonymise it or change its meaning
questions.explanation: In Data Parsing, data is neither anonymised nor does its meaning change; it changes only for the sake of being understandable.

questions.stem: From which Latin phrase does the term parsing come?
options: Pars orationis, meaning part of speech
questions.explanation: Parsing comes from the Latin pars (orationis), meaning part (of speech).

questions.stem: What does Lexical Analysis create during Data Parsing?
options: Tokens such as keywords, identifiers and delimiters
questions.explanation: Lexical Analysis creates tokens (keywords, identifiers and delimiters) in unstructured or unformatted data, so irrelevant text can be ignored.

questions.stem: How does Syntactic Analysis arrange the relevant tokens produced during parsing?
options: Using parentheses, curly braces and semicolons
questions.explanation: Syntactic Analysis takes the relevant tokens and arranges them in three parses: parentheses, curly braces and semicolons.

questions.stem: What does Semantic Analysis do in Data Parsing?
options: Segregates data based on business requirements, for example Yes or No, Open or Close or WIP
questions.explanation: Semantic Analysis is an additional step based on business requirements that segregates data, such as Yes or No or Open, Close or WIP, making it more relevant.

questions.stem: When is Web Scraping used to extract data from online portals?
options: When the portal does not provide an API
When the portal provides a well-documented API
Only when data is already in JSON
When the data is fully structured in a database
questions.explanation: Portals that provide APIs allow extraction in a readable format; for those that do not, Web Scraping crawls the site using different parsing approaches.

questions.stem: Into which readable format is HTML sometimes parsed?
questions.explanation: Sometimes HTML is parsed into JSON, a readable format.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT listed among the parsing techniques?
questions.explanation: The listed techniques are scripting languages, HTML and XML, interactive data language, modelling languages, SQL and database languages, and HTTPS and Internet Protocols.

questions.stem: Which step of Data Parsing is described as an additional step driven by business requirements?
questions.explanation: Semantic Analysis is an addition step based on business requirement, following Lexical and Syntactic Analysis.
